source.relation: Independent mechanism alternative; declared causal NVDA/AMD adaptation, not exact hosted tutorial or original 2013-2014 reproduction

context.training: For every close use exactly250 strictly prior aligned sessions from600calendar-day daily-history requests; SCALED_RAW normalizes only actions known by current decision time. Current close is excluded from fitting; used only for residual scoring. No pre-2016 trades or NAV; 2015 history seeds features.
context.signal: Regress AMD(Y) on NVDA(X) in price levels plus constant. Cointegration-specific statsmodels.coint, trend c, maxlag5, AIC; require p<.05, beta>0 and negative lag-residual coefficient in the source-inspired error-correction regression. Compute current dimensionless residual z using prior-sample mean/sample SD. Flat enters longX/shortY at z>=1, inverse at z<=-1. Retain direction until zero crossing or gate fails, then cash. Daily refitting/rebalancing; no parameter grid or maximum holding stop.
context.execution: After close t queue percentage weights for next session9:32; raw current prices determine native quantities. Hedge shares ratio beta translated into dollar weights using decision prices; absolute target weights sum.98. Native ordered reductions/increases; final-close queued signal is unexecuted, no forced terminal liquidation. Holdings may drift beyond targets.
context.controls: spy:98% SPY purchase once at Jan5,2016 9:32 after first shared Jan4 close; pairhold:49%NVDA+49%AMD at that same time, no rebalance. All cases subscribe to all3symbols and fit the same features to audit parity. Pairhold diagnoses long-asset opportunity cost, not a net/beta/exposure-matched control.
context.costs: Native IB commissions + fixed5bp/fill and native quote/fill defaults. Native raw-mode splits and dividend cash credits/debits, including short dividends. Funding6%ACT/360 prior-closing-negativecash,zero credit,native interest disabled. Short borrow3%ACT/365 on previous-event short notional times UTC elapsed seconds including overnight/weekends; native historical availability/locates assumed, not verified. Taxes/locate/recall/capacity not modeled.
context.data: Free hosted US equities/security-master history and minute bars. RAW execution avoids future full-history normalization; SCALED_RAW fit data uses known actions. Existing account access must pass a zero-order probe over all2514sessions and both NVDA splits. Only own aggregates/counts/hashes exported, no raw market paths.
context.metrics: Full/annual return, closing DD, sample-daily zeroRF Sharpe sqrt252, full calendar-CAGR/absDD and annual return/absDD Calmar, UWfraction/longest sessions/calendar days/terminal censoring. Additional minute-mark DD, mean/max gross, mean net, short minute count, eligible-day fraction, dividends/borrow/fees and daily native book residual.

risks: Original full-sample max-price sizing is future aware; source ADF residual p-value uses inappropriate ordinary unit-root reference after estimated regression; trigger bands mix z and price SD, holding state resets daily. All repaired as declared mechanism adaptation.
The source-selected NVDA/AMD pair is an ex-post surviving pair and already discussed in2018; 2016-2025is viewed development history, not untouched selection validation.
Cointegration gate assumes I(1), has rolling multiple-testing/relationship-breakdown risks and is not a stable-profits certificate. No broad pair search or inference of causality from PnL.
hypothesis: A causal cointegration-gated pair offers useful positive net risk-adjusted performance versus SPY after realistic stated friction assumptions.
primary_estimand: Full Calmar(pairs)-Calmar(SPY), conditional on positive pair CAGR; growth and temporal criteria are separately fixed diagnostics.

decision_rule.growth: Retain for independent validation only if CAGR>SPY,Calmar>=SPY,longestUW<=SPY.
decision_rule.risk_alternative: Retain as a risk-research alternative only if CAGR>0,Sharpe>=SPY,DD<SPY,longestUW<=SPY. If neither screen passes, stop this fixed adaptation; no retuning on viewed history.
decision_rule.drawdown: Closing or minute DD>30% flags reassessment, not hard loss bound.

gates: Free zero-order probe:10annual checkpoints,250strict-prior aligned history observations each day,2514ready sessions,raw normalization,actual dependencies/nativeIBmodel,zero orders,>=2NVDA splits and>=30NVDA/SPY dividend events.

Fresh SPY must reconcile before two other finance cases. All4fit hashes and3financial calendars/minute counts must match. Native daily/lifetime book residual<=USD2; fee/lastmarkresidual<=USD.01; no invalid/pending orders/nonpositive NAV.
stops: Reserve before every launch;<=6total attempts,<=2technical retries;deadline90minutes. Failures count; source/build/engine drift stops dependent runs until explicit archived technical amendment.

No financial run if input gate blocked. No results-driven asset/parameter/cost search, paid resources, dependencies, new services, MLflow import, agents, broker/account/order operations, commits or publication.
